integrity: The foundational preprint was inspected in full text, including the exact equations, equilibrium, local linearization, and chaotic positive-parameter example. The full coexistence paper and the full generalized Sprott-E paper were inspected directly. The forcing-specific conditional law and weighted-height identity were reconstructed from invariant-measure generator identities and replayed with a packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Previously covered zero-forcing Sprott-E stationary identities are used only as proof ingredients and are not treated as new.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not prove existence of non-equilibrium attractors for every positive parameter.
The y-weighted measure used in the exact height formula is not asserted to be invariant.
The excursion conclusion forces positive mass above the equilibrium height and below zero, not positive mass below the equilibrium height.
The complete 2020 global-geometry article was unavailable in a securely inspectable full-text form.
A differently phrased or unindexed stationary identity could remain unlocated.
title: Exact y-weighted height contraction for hidden recurrence in the Wang–Chen flow
